newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Northeast spot power steady amid cold weather.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Northeast spot power steady amid cold weather.

text.p: Spot wholesale electricity prices in the northeastern U.S. ended Wednesday steady against Tuesday's levels in lackluster activity ahead of the U.S. Thanksgiving holiday weekend.

Forecast of well-below temperatures, about 10-15 degrees below normal, for the rest of the week offset bearish pressure from lower baseload power usage by many industrial and large commercial customers over the holiday weekend, marketers said.
Although spot natural gas prices in the Northeast were weaker in sympathy with the Gulf market, replacement cost for gas as well as fuel oil remained high, marketers said.
"Fuel prices are high, but power prices remained in ranges where they have been for the past couple of weeks," said a marketer in Houston.

December baseload natural gas at the New York City gate was still valued near $5.00 per million British thermal units. The wide-used one-percent sulphur fuel oil in the New York harbor held steady at $22.50-$22.50 a barrel.

In the western part of the New York Power Pool (NYPP) district, peak, non-firm electricity prices for Friday and Monday valued at $22.00-$25.00 a megawatt hour (MWh), flat from Tuesday's prices for Wednesday.
Western NYPP peak, non-firm deliveries for the weekend were notationally pegged at $21.00-$23.00.
Western NYPP power for non-firm delivery during light load hours on Friday and Monday held steady at $14.00-$15.00 and on Saturday and Sunday at $12.00-$14.00.
December power in western NYPP was still discussed at $24.00-$27.00.
In the eastern part of NYPP, peak, non-firm electricity for Friday and Monday remained in the $28.00-$29.00 range.
Eastern NYPP peak, non-firm deliveries for the weekend were notationally quoted at $26.00-$28.00.
Off-peak, non-firm power in eastern NYPP was talked for Friday and Monday at $18.50-$19.00, flat from Tuesday's quote for Wednesday.
Eastern NYPP off-peak, non-firm deliveries for the weekend were notationally quoted at $17.00-$18.00.
December electricity in the eastern half of NYPP was still discussed at $31.00-$33.00

In the New England Power Pool (NEPOOL), peak, non-firm electricity for Friday and Monday at the Northeast Utilities border was quoted at $33.00-$35.00, compared with Tuesday's offers which reached as high as $35.00-$36.00.
Peak, non-firm weekend deliveries at the NU border was notationally valued at $32.00-$34.00.
Non-firm, off-peak NEPOOL power for Friday and Monday delivery to the NU border stayed near $21.00.
Non-firm, off-peak NEPOOL power for weekend delivery ato the NU system was notationally quoted near $20.00.
December deliveries to the NU border were still assessed at $35.00-$41.00.
Most New York and New England utilities will close Thursday and Friday in observance of the Thanksgiving holiday.
--R Leong, New York Power Desk +1 212 859 1622
